module Core (

      
	clk,

	nextMemReadSerial,

	input wire clk;

	input wire rstStart;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_DCACHE_MSHR_NUM = 2;

				adderInvInA = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				adderInB = 1'sb0;

      
				adderInvInB = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				adderInCarry = 0;

      
				opDst = {32'h00000000, opA < opB};

      
			end

      
			4'b0110: begin

      
				adderInA = 1'sb0;

      
				adderInvInA = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				adderInB = 1'sb0;

      
				adderInvInB = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				adderInCarry = 0;

      
				opDst = {1'b0, opA | opB};

      
			end

      
		endcase

      
		aluDataOut = opDst[31-:BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH];

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module OrgShifter (

      
	shiftOperandType,

      
	shiftType,

      
	immShiftAmount,

      
	regShiftAmount,

      
	dataIn,

      
	carryIn,

      
	dataOut,

      
	carryOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire shiftOperandType;

      
	input wire [1:0] shiftType;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_SHIFT_AMOUNT_BIT_SIZE = 5;

      
	input wire [4:0] immShiftAmount;

      
	input wire [4:0] regShiftAmount;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] dataIn;

      
	input wire carryIn;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	output reg carryOut;

      
	function automatic [32:0] OpImmShift;

      
		input reg [1:0] shiftType;

      
		input reg [4:0] shiftAmount;

      
		input reg [31:0] dataIn;

      
		input reg carryIn;

      
		reg [BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:0] shiftTmp;

      
		reg [32:0] result;

      
		reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
		reg carryOut;

      
		begin

      
			case (shiftType)

      
				default:

      
					if (shiftAmount == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = dataIn;

      
						carryOut = carryIn;

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = dataIn << shiftAmount;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[31:0];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH];

      
					end

      
				2'b01:

      
					if (shiftAmount == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = 0;

      
						carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftAmount;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
				2'b10:

      
					if (shiftAmount == 0) begin

      
						if (dataIn[31] == 0) begin

      
							dataOut = 0;

      
							carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
						end

      
						else begin

      
							dataOut = 32'hffffffff;

      
							carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
						end

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {{BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH {dataIn[31]}}, dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftAmount;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
				2'b11:

      
					if (shiftAmount == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = {carryIn, dataIn[31:1]};

      
						carryOut = dataIn[0];

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {dataIn, dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftAmount;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
			endcase

      
			result[32-:32] = dataOut;

      
			result[0] = carryOut;

      
			OpImmShift = result;

      
		end

      
	endfunction

      
	function automatic [32:0] OpRegShift;

      
		input reg [1:0] shiftType;

      
		input reg [4:0] shiftAmount;

      
		input reg [31:0] dataIn;

      
		input reg [4:0] shiftIn;

      
		input reg carryIn;

      
		reg [BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:0] shiftTmp;

      
		reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
		reg carryOut;

      
		reg [32:0] result;

      
		begin

      
			case (shiftType)

      
				default:

      
					if (shiftIn == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = dataIn;

      
						carryOut = carryIn;

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = dataIn << shiftIn;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[31:0];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH];

      
					end

      
				2'b01:

      
					if (shiftIn == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = 0;

      
						carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftIn;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
				2'b10:

      
					if (shiftIn == 0) begin

      
						if (dataIn[31] == 0) begin

      
							dataOut = 0;

      
							carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
						end

      
						else begin

      
							dataOut = 32'hffffffff;

      
							carryOut = dataIn[31];

      
						end

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {{BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH {dataIn[31]}}, dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftAmount;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
				2'b11:

      
					if (shiftIn == 0) begin

      
						dataOut = {carryIn, dataIn[31:1]};

      
						carryOut = dataIn[0];

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						shiftTmp = {dataIn, dataIn, 1'b0} >> shiftIn;

      
						dataOut = shiftTmp[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
						carryOut = shiftTmp[0];

      
					end

      
			endcase

      
			result[32-:32] = dataOut;

      
			result[0] = carryOut;

      
			OpRegShift = result;

      
		end

      
	endfunction

      
	reg [32:0] shiftResult;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		case (shiftType)

      
			default: shiftResult = OpImmShift(shiftType, immShiftAmount, dataIn, carryIn);

      
			1'b1: shiftResult = OpRegShift(shiftType, immShiftAmount, dataIn, regShiftAmount, carryIn);

      
		endcase

      
		dataOut = shiftResult[32-:32];

      
		carryOut = shiftResult[0];

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module Shifter (

      
	shiftOperandType,

      
	shiftType,

      
	immShiftAmount,

      
	regShiftAmount,

      
	dataIn,

      
	carryIn,

      
	dataOut,

      
	carryOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire shiftOperandType;

      
	input wire [1:0] shiftType;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_SHIFT_AMOUNT_BIT_SIZE = 5;

      
	input wire [4:0] immShiftAmount;

      
	input wire [4:0] regShiftAmount;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] dataIn;

      
	input wire carryIn;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	output reg carryOut;

      
	reg [4:0] shiftAmount;

      
	reg [65:0] unifiedShiftTmp;

      
	reg [31:0] unifiedShiftHighIn;

      
	reg [31:0] unifiedShiftLowIn;

      
	reg [33:0] unifiedShiftOut;

      
	reg [BasicTypes_SHIFT_AMOUNT_BIT_SIZE:0] unifiedShiftAmount;

      
	reg isShiftZero;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		case (shiftOperandType)

      
			default: shiftAmount = immShiftAmount;

      
			1'b1: shiftAmount = regShiftAmount;

      
		endcase

      
		isShiftZero = (shiftAmount == 0 ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		case (shiftType)

      
			2'b00: begin

      
				unifiedShiftAmount = BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH - shiftAmount;

      
				unifiedShiftHighIn = dataIn;

      
				unifiedShiftLowIn = 0;

      
			end

      
			2'b01: begin

      
				unifiedShiftAmount = shiftAmount;

      
				unifiedShiftHighIn = 0;

      
				unifiedShiftLowIn = dataIn;

      
			end

      
			2'b10: begin

      
				unifiedShiftAmount = shiftAmount;

      
				unifiedShiftHighIn = {BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH {dataIn[31]}};

      
				unifiedShiftLowIn = dataIn;

      
			end

      
			2'b11: begin

      
				unifiedShiftAmount = shiftAmount;

      
				unifiedShiftHighIn = {dataIn[31:1], (isShiftZero ? carryIn : dataIn[0])};

      
				unifiedShiftLowIn = dataIn;

      
			end

      
		endcase

      
		unifiedShiftTmp = {carryIn, unifiedShiftHighIn, unifiedShiftLowIn, 1'b0};

      
		case (unifiedShiftAmount[5:4])

      
			2'h3: unifiedShiftTmp = 49'hxxxxxxxxxxxxx;

      
			2'h2: unifiedShiftTmp = {15'hxxxx, unifiedShiftTmp[65:32]};

      
			2'h1: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[64:16];

      
			2'h0: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[48:0];

      
		endcase

      
		case (unifiedShiftAmount[3:2])

      
			2'h3: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[48:12];

      
			2'h2: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[44:8];

      
			2'h1: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[40:4];

      
			2'h0: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[36:0];

      
		endcase

      
		case (unifiedShiftAmount[1:0])

      
			2'h3: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[36:3];

      
			2'h2: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[35:2];

      
			2'h1: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[34:1];

      
			2'h0: unifiedShiftTmp = unifiedShiftTmp[33:0];

      
		endcase

      
		unifiedShiftOut = unifiedShiftTmp;

      
		dataOut = unifiedShiftOut[BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH:1];

      
		case (shiftType)

      
			2'b00: carryOut = unifiedShiftOut[33];

      
			default: carryOut = unifiedShiftOut[0];

      
		endcase

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module MultiplierUnit (

      
	fuOpA_In,

      
	fuOpB_In,

      
	getUpper,

      
	dataOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpA_In;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpB_In;

      
	input wire getUpper;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	wire [63:0] mulResult;

      
	Multiplier #(.BIT_WIDTH(BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH)) mul(

      
		.srcA(fuOpA_In),

      
		.srcB(fuOpB_In),

      
		.dst(mulResult)

      
	);

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (getUpper)

      
			dataOut = mulResult[63:BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH];

      
		else

      
			dataOut = mulResult[31:0];

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module PipelinedMultiplierUnit (

      
	clk,

      
	stall,

      
	fuOpA_In,

      
	fuOpB_In,

      
	getUpper,

      
	mulCode,

      
	dataOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter PIPELINE_DEPTH = 3;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire stall;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpA_In;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpB_In;

      
	input wire getUpper;

      
	input wire [1:0] mulCode;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	reg [4:0] pipeReg [0:PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2];

      
	wire [63:0] mulResult;

      
	wire signed [31:0] fuOpA_signed;

      
	wire signed [31:0] fuOpB_signed;

      
	wire fuOpA_sign;

      
	wire fuOpB_sign;

      
	reg signA;

      
	reg signB;

      
	reg [31:0] srcA;

      
	reg [31:0] srcB;

      
	PipelinedMultiplier #(

      
		.BIT_WIDTH(BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH),

      
		.PIPELINE_DEPTH(PIPELINE_DEPTH)

      
	) mul(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stall(stall),

      
		.srcA(srcA),

      
		.srcB(srcB),

      
		.signA(signA),

      
		.signB(signB),

      
		.dst(mulResult)

      
	);

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (mulCode == 2'b11)

      
			signA = 1'sb0;

      
		else

      
			signA = 1'sb1;

      
		if ((mulCode == 2'b11) || (mulCode == 2'b10))

      
			signB = 1'sb0;

      
		else

      
			signB = 1'sb1;

      
		srcA = fuOpA_In;

      
		srcB = fuOpB_In;

      
	end

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][4])

      
			dataOut = mulResult[63:BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH];

      
		else

      
			dataOut = mulResult[31:0];

      
	end

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (stall) begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < (PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1); i = i + 1)

      
				pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i];

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			pipeReg[0][4] <= getUpper;

      
			pipeReg[0][3-:2] <= mulCode;

      
			pipeReg[0][1] <= fuOpA_sign;

      
			pipeReg[0][0] <= fuOpB_sign;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 1; i < (PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1); i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i - 1];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module PipelinedRefDivider (

      
	clk,

      
	stall,

      
	dividend,

      
	divisor,

      
	isSigned,

      
	quotient,

      
	remainder

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter PIPELINE_DEPTH = 3;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire stall;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] dividend;

      
	input wire [31:0] divisor;

      
	input wire isSigned;

      
	output reg [31:0] quotient;

      
	output reg [31:0] remainder;

      
	parameter DATA_MINUS_ONE = 34'sd4294967296 - 1;

      
	parameter DATA_MINIMUM = 33'sd2147483648;

      
	wire [1:0] regPhase;

      
	wire [1:0] nextPhase;

      
	reg [130:0] pipeReg [0:PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2];

      
	reg [130:0] nextReg;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (!stall) begin

      
			pipeReg[0] <= nextReg;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 1; i < (PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1); i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i - 1];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		quotient = pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][65-:32];

      
		remainder = pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][33-:32];

      
		nextReg[130-:32] = dividend;

      
		nextReg[98-:32] = divisor;

      
		nextReg[66] = isSigned;

      
		if (divisor == 0) begin

      
			nextReg[65-:32] = -1;

      
			nextReg[33-:32] = dividend;

      
		end

      
		else if (!isSigned) begin

      
			if ((dividend == DATA_MINIMUM) && (divisor == DATA_MINUS_ONE)) begin

      
				nextReg[65-:32] = dividend;

      
				nextReg[33-:32] = 1'sb0;

      
			end

      
			else begin

      
				nextReg[65-:32] = $signed(dividend) / $signed(divisor);

      
				nextReg[33-:32] = $signed(dividend) % $signed(divisor);

      
			end

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			nextReg[65-:32] = dividend / divisor;

      
			nextReg[33-:32] = dividend % divisor;

      
		end

      
		nextReg[1-:2] = 2'd0;

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module DividerUnit (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	req,

      
	fuOpA_In,

      
	fuOpB_In,

      
	divCode,

      
	finished,

      
	dataOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire req;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpA_In;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpB_In;

      
	input wire [1:0] divCode;

      
	output wire finished;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	reg regIsSigned;

      
	reg nextIsSigned;

      
	reg [31:0] regDividend;

      
	reg [31:0] nextDividend;

      
	reg [31:0] regDivisor;

      
	reg [31:0] nextDivisor;

      
	reg [1:0] regDivCode;

      
	reg [1:0] nextDivCode;

      
	wire [31:0] quotient;

      
	wire [31:0] remainder;

      
	QuickDivider div(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.rst(rst),

      
		.req(req),

      
		.dividend(nextDividend),

      
		.divisor(nextDivisor),

      
		.isSigned(nextIsSigned),

      
		.finished(finished),

      
		.quotient(quotient),

      
		.remainder(remainder)

      
	);

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			regIsSigned <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			regDividend <= 1'sb0;

      
			regDivisor <= 1'sb0;

      
			regDivCode <= 2'b00;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			regIsSigned <= nextIsSigned;

      
			regDividend <= nextDividend;

      
			regDivisor <= nextDivisor;

      
			regDivCode <= nextDivCode;

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (req) begin

      
			if ((divCode == 2'b01) || (divCode == 2'b11))

      
				nextIsSigned = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			else

      
				nextIsSigned = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			nextDividend = fuOpA_In;

      
			nextDivisor = fuOpB_In;

      
			nextDivCode = divCode;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			nextIsSigned = regIsSigned;

      
			nextDividend = regDividend;

      
			nextDivisor = regDivisor;

      
			nextDivCode = regDivCode;

      
		end

      
		if ((regDivCode == 2'b00) || (regDivCode == 2'b01))

      
			dataOut = quotient;

      
		else

      
			dataOut = remainder;

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module PipelinedDividerUnit (

      
	clk,

      
	stall,

      
	req,

      
	fuOpA_In,

      
	fuOpB_In,

      
	divCode,

      
	finished,

      
	dataOut

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter PIPELINE_DEPTH = 3;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire stall;

      
	input wire req;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpA_In;

      
	input wire [31:0] fuOpB_In;

      
	input wire [1:0] divCode;

      
	output reg finished;

      
	output reg [31:0] dataOut;

      
	reg [3:0] pipeReg [0:PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2];

      
	reg [3:0] nextReg;

      
	wire [31:0] quotient;

      
	wire [31:0] remainder;

      
	reg isSigned;

      
	reg [31:0] dividend;

      
	reg [31:0] divisor;

      
	PipelinedRefDivider #(

      
		.BIT_WIDTH(BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH),

      
		.PIPELINE_DEPTH(PIPELINE_DEPTH)

      
	) div(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stall(stall),

      
		.dividend(dividend),

      
		.divisor(divisor),

      
		.isSigned(isSigned),

      
		.quotient(quotient),

      
		.remainder(remainder)

      
	);

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (!stall) begin

      
			pipeReg[0] <= nextReg;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 1; i < (PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1); i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i - 1];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if ((divCode == 2'b01) || (divCode == 2'b11))

      
			isSigned = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		else

      
			isSigned = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		dividend = fuOpA_In;

      
		divisor = fuOpB_In;

      
		nextReg[2] = isSigned;

      
		nextReg[1-:2] = divCode;

      
		nextReg[3] = req;

      
		if (pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][3]) begin

      
			if ((pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][1-:2] == 2'b00) || (pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2][1-:2] == 2'b01))

      
				dataOut = quotient;

      
			else

      
				dataOut = remainder;

      
			finished = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			dataOut = 1'sb0;

      
			finished = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
	end

module FMulStage0 (

					end

	FMAStage0 stg0(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stg0Out(stg0Out),

      
		.mullhs(mullhs),

      
		.mulrhs(mulrhs),

      
		.addend(addend),

      
		.is_subtract(is_sub),

      
		.mlhs(mlhs),

      
		.mrhs(mrhs),

      
		.maddend(maddend)

      
	);

      
	FMAStage1 stg1(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stg1In(stg0Out),

      
		.stg1Out(stg1Out)

      
	);

      
	FMAStage2 stg2(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stg2In(stg1Out),

      
		.stg2Out(stg2Out),

      
		.fma_result(fma_result)

      
	);

      
	FMAStage3 stg3(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stg3In(stg2Out),

      
		.stg3Out(stg3Out)

      
	);

      
	FMAStage4 stg4(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.stg4In(stg3Out),

      
		.result(result)

      
	);

      
endmodule

      
module FMAStage0 (

      
	clk,

      
	stg0Out,

      
	mullhs,

      
	mulrhs,

      
	addend,

      
	is_subtract,

      
	mlhs,

      
	mrhs,

      
	maddend

      
);

      
	input wire clk;

      
	output wire [80:0] stg0Out;

      
	input wire [31:0] mullhs;

      
	input wire [31:0] mulrhs;

      
	input wire [31:0] addend;

      
	output wire is_subtract;

      
	output wire [76:0] mlhs;

      
	output wire [76:0] mrhs;

      
	output wire [76:0] maddend;

      
	wire mullhs_sign = mullhs[31];

      
	wire mulrhs_sign = mulrhs[31];

      
	wire addend_sign = addend[31];

      
	wire [7:0] mullhs_expo = mullhs[30:23];

      
	wire [7:0] mulrhs_expo = mulrhs[30:23];

      
	wire [7:0] addend_expo = addend[30:23];

      
	wire [22:0] mullhs_mant = mullhs[22:0];

      
	wire [22:0] mulrhs_mant = mulrhs[22:0];

      
	wire [22:0] addend_mant = addend[22:0];

      
	assign is_subtract = (mullhs_sign ^ mulrhs_sign) ^ addend_sign;

      
	wire mullhs_is_zero = (mullhs_expo == 8'h00) & (mullhs_mant == 0);

      
	wire mulrhs_is_zero = (mulrhs_expo == 8'h00) & (mulrhs_mant == 0);

      
	wire addend_is_zero = (addend_expo == 8'h00) & (addend_mant == 0);

      
	wire mullhs_is_inf = (mullhs_expo == 8'hff) & (mullhs_mant == 0);

      
	wire mulrhs_is_inf = (mulrhs_expo == 8'hff) & (mulrhs_mant == 0);

      
	wire addend_is_inf = (addend_expo == 8'hff) & (addend_mant == 0);

      
	wire mullhs_is_nan = (mullhs_expo == 8'hff) & (mullhs_mant != 0);

      
	wire mulrhs_is_nan = (mulrhs_expo == 8'hff) & (mulrhs_mant != 0);

      
	wire addend_is_nan = (addend_expo == 8'hff) & (addend_mant != 0);

      
	wire result_is_nan = ((((mullhs_is_nan | mulrhs_is_nan) | addend_is_nan) | (mullhs_is_zero & mulrhs_is_inf)) | (mullhs_is_inf & mulrhs_is_zero)) | ((is_subtract & (mullhs_is_inf | mulrhs_is_inf)) & addend_is_inf);

      
	wire [31:0] nan = 32'h7fc00000;

      
	wire result_is_inf = (addend_is_inf | mullhs_is_inf) | mulrhs_is_inf;

      
	wire prop_inf_sign = (addend_is_inf ? addend_sign : mullhs_sign ^ mulrhs_sign);

      
	wire mul_sign = mullhs_sign ^ mulrhs_sign;

      
	wire [9:0] v_mullhs_expo = {2'b00, (mullhs_expo == 8'h00 ? 8'h01 : mullhs_expo)};

      
	wire [9:0] v_mulrhs_expo = {2'b00, (mulrhs_expo == 8'h00 ? 8'h01 : mulrhs_expo)};

      
	wire [9:0] v_addend_expo = {2'b00, (addend_expo == 8'h00 ? 8'h01 : addend_expo)};

      
	wire [9:0] mulres_expo = (v_mullhs_expo + v_mulrhs_expo) - 127;

      
	wire [9:0] addend_shift = (v_addend_expo - mulres_expo) + 23;

      
	wire res_is_addend = ((($signed(addend_shift) > 49) | mullhs_is_zero) | mulrhs_is_zero) & !addend_is_zero;

      
	wire addend_sticky = ($signed(addend_shift) >= 0 ? 1'b0 : ($signed(addend_shift) < -26 ? {addend_expo != 8'h00, addend_mant} != 0 : ({addend_expo != 8'h00, addend_mant} << (10'd26 + addend_shift)) != 24'h000000));

      
	assign maddend = {1'b0, {addend_expo != 8'h00, addend_mant, 51'b000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000} >> (10'd49 - addend_shift), addend_sticky};

      
	assign mlhs = {51'b000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000, mullhs_expo != 8'h00, mullhs_mant, 2'b00};

      
	assign mrhs = {52'b0000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000, mulrhs_expo != 8'h00, mulrhs_mant, 1'b0};

      
	assign stg0Out = {mulres_expo, result_is_inf, result_is_nan, res_is_addend, mul_sign, prop_inf_sign, addend_sign, is_subtract, nan, addend};

      
endmodule

      
module FMAStage1 (

      
	clk,

      
	stg1In,

      
	stg1Out

      
);

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire [80:0] stg1In;

      
	output wire [80:0] stg1Out;

      
	reg [80:0] pipeReg;

      
	always @(posedge clk) pipeReg <= stg1In;

      
	assign stg1Out = pipeReg;

      
endmodule

      
module FMAStage2 (

      
	clk,

      
	stg2In,

      
	stg2Out,

      
	fma_result

      
);

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire [80:0] stg2In;

      
	output wire [158:0] stg2Out;

      
	input wire [76:0] fma_result;

      
	reg [80:0] pipeReg;

      
	always @(posedge clk) pipeReg <= stg2In;

      
	wire mul_sign = pipeReg[67];

      
	wire res_is_zero = fma_result == 77'h00000000000000000000;

      
	wire res_is_negative = fma_result[76];

      
	wire [75:0] abs_fma_result = (res_is_negative ? -fma_result[75:0] : fma_result[75:0]);

      
	wire result_sign = mul_sign ^ res_is_negative;

      
	assign stg2Out = {abs_fma_result, pipeReg[80-:10], res_is_negative, pipeReg[70], pipeReg[69], res_is_zero, pipeReg[68], result_sign, pipeReg[66], pipeReg[65], pipeReg[64], pipeReg[63-:32], pipeReg[31-:32]};

      
endmodule

      
module FMAStage3 (

      
	clk,

      
	stg3In,

      
	stg3Out

      
);

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire [158:0] stg3In;

      
	output wire [167:0] stg3Out;

      
	function automatic [6:0] leading_zeros_count;

      
		input [75:0] x;

      
		reg [0:1] _sv2v_jump;

      
		begin

      
			_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg [6:0] _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				for (leading_zeros_count = 0; leading_zeros_count <= 75; leading_zeros_count = leading_zeros_count + 1)

      
					if (_sv2v_jump < 2'b10) begin

      
						_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
						if (x[75 - leading_zeros_count])

      
							_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
						_sv2v_value_on_break = leading_zeros_count;

      
					end

      
				if (!(_sv2v_jump < 2'b10))

      
					leading_zeros_count = _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				if (_sv2v_jump != 2'b11)

      
					_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			end

      
		end

      
	endfunction

      
	reg [158:0] pipeReg;

      
	always @(posedge clk) pipeReg <= stg3In;

      
	wire [75:0] abs_fma_result = pipeReg[158-:76];

      
	wire [9:0] mulres_expo = pipeReg[82-:10];

      
	wire [7:0] leading_zeros = {1'b0, leading_zeros_count(abs_fma_result)};

      
	wire [9:0] virtual_expo = (mulres_expo - {2'b00, leading_zeros}) + 26;

      
	wire subnormal = $signed(virtual_expo) <= 0;

      
	wire [7:0] fmares_shift = (subnormal ? 26 - mulres_expo[7:0] : 51 - leading_zeros);

      
	assign stg3Out = {abs_fma_result, fmares_shift, virtual_expo, subnormal, pipeReg[72], pipeReg[71], pipeReg[70], pipeReg[69], pipeReg[68], pipeReg[67], pipeReg[66], pipeReg[65], pipeReg[64], pipeReg[63-:32], pipeReg[31-:32]};

      
endmodule

      
module FMAStage4 (

      
	clk,

      
	stg4In,

      
	result

      
);

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire [167:0] stg4In;

      
	output wire [31:0] result;

      
	reg [167:0] pipeReg;

      
	always @(posedge clk) pipeReg <= stg4In;

      
	wire [75:0] abs_fma_result = pipeReg[167-:76];

      
	wire [7:0] fmares_shift = pipeReg[91-:8];

      
	wire [9:0] virtual_expo = pipeReg[83-:10];

      
	wire [31:0] nan = pipeReg[63-:32];

      
	wire [31:0] addend = pipeReg[31-:32];

      
	wire res_is_negative = pipeReg[72];

      
	wire result_is_inf = pipeReg[71];

      
	wire result_is_nan = pipeReg[70];

      
	wire res_is_zero = pipeReg[69];

      
	wire res_is_addend = pipeReg[68];

      
	wire result_sign = pipeReg[67];

      
	wire prop_inf_sign = pipeReg[66];

      
	wire addend_sign = pipeReg[65];

      
	wire subnormal = pipeReg[73];

      
	wire is_subtract = pipeReg[64];

      
	wire [23:0] shifter_result = {abs_fma_result, 23'b00000000000000000000000} >> (7'd23 + fmares_shift);

      
	wire sticky = (abs_fma_result << (76 - fmares_shift)) != 0;

      
	wire round_to_away = shifter_result[0] & (shifter_result[1] | sticky);

      
	wire exp_plus_one = shifter_result >= 24'hffffff;

      
	wire [22:0] result_mant = shifter_result[23:1] + {22'h000000, round_to_away};

      
	wire [7:0] result_expo = (subnormal ? 8'h00 : virtual_expo[7:0]) + {7'b0000000, exp_plus_one};

      
	wire res_is_inf = result_is_inf | ($signed(virtual_expo) >= 255);

      
	wire [31:0] inf = {(result_is_inf ? prop_inf_sign : result_sign), 31'h7f800000};

      
	wire [31:0] zero = {(is_subtract ? 1'b0 : addend_sign), 31'h00000000};

      
	wire [31:0] final_result = (res_is_inf ? inf : (res_is_addend ? addend : (res_is_zero ? zero : {result_sign, result_expo, result_mant})));

      
	assign result = (result_is_nan ? nan : final_result);

      
endmodule

      
module FP32PipelinedOther (

      
	clk,

      
	lhs,

      
	rhs,

      
	fpuCode,

      
	rm,

      
	result,

      
	fflags

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter PIPELINE_DEPTH = 5;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire [31:0] lhs;

      
	input wire [31:0] rhs;

      
	input wire [4:0] fpuCode;

      
	input wire [2:0] rm;

      
	output reg [31:0] result;

      
	output reg [4:0] fflags;

      
	reg [31:0] resultOut;

      
	reg [4:0] fflagsOut;

      
	reg [36:0] pipeReg [0:PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2];

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (PIPELINE_DEPTH > 1)

      
			{result, fflags} = pipeReg[0];

      
		else

      
			{result, fflags} = {resultOut, fflagsOut};

      
	end

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (PIPELINE_DEPTH > 1) begin

      
			pipeReg[PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2] <= {resultOut, fflagsOut};

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 1; i < (PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1); i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i - 1] <= pipeReg[i];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	reg lhs_sign;

      
	reg rhs_sign;

      
	reg [7:0] lhs_expo;

      
	reg [7:0] rhs_expo;

      
	reg [22:0] lhs_mant;

      
	reg [22:0] rhs_mant;

      
	reg lhs_is_zero;

      
	reg rhs_is_zero;

      
	reg lhs_is_inf;

      
	reg rhs_is_inf;

      
	reg lhs_is_nan;

      
	reg rhs_is_nan;

      
	reg lhs_is_snan;

      
	reg rhs_is_snan;

      
	reg lhs_is_subnormal;

      
	reg lhs_is_normal;

      
	reg lhs_is_smaller;

      
	reg lhs_equal_rhs;

      
	reg fmt_unsigned;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	task automatic FP32CVT_F2I;

      
		input reg [31:0] lhs;

      
		input reg fmt_unsigned;

      
		input reg [2:0] rm;

      
		output reg [31:0] result;

      
		output reg [4:0] fflags;

      
		reg sign;

      
		reg [7:0] expo;

      
		reg [22:0] mant;

      
		reg [4:0] shift_amount;

      
		reg [31:0] int_result;

      
		reg [31:0] abs_result;

      
		reg [22:0] lower_bits;

      
		reg round_up;

      
		reg lsb;

      
		reg guard;

      
		reg sticky;

      
		reg is_invalid;

      
		reg lhs_is_neg;

      
		reg lhs_is_nan;

      
		begin

      
			{sign, expo, mant} = lhs;

      
			shift_amount = 158 - expo;

      
			lhs_is_neg = sign;

      
			lhs_is_nan = (expo == 8'hff) & (mant != 0);

      
			if (expo <= 126) begin

      
				int_result = 0;

      
				lsb = 0;

      
				guard = (expo == 126 ? 1 : 0);

      
				sticky = ((expo == 0) || (expo == 126) ? |mant : 1);

      
			end

      
			else if (expo <= 157) begin

      
				{int_result, lower_bits} = {1'b1, mant, 31'h00000000} >> shift_amount;

      
				lsb = int_result[0];

      
				{guard, sticky} = {lower_bits[22], |lower_bits[21:0]};

      
			end

      
			else if (expo == 158) begin

      
				if (fmt_unsigned)

      
					int_result = (lhs_is_neg ? 32'h00000000 : {1'b1, mant, 8'h00});

      
				else

      
					int_result = (lhs_is_neg ? 32'h80000000 : 32'h7fffffff);

      
			end

      
			else if (fmt_unsigned)

      
				int_result = (~lhs_is_nan & lhs_is_neg ? 32'h00000000 : 32'hffffffff);

      
			else

      
				int_result = (~lhs_is_nan & lhs_is_neg ? 32'h80000000 : 32'h7fffffff);

      
			case (rm)

      
				3'b000: round_up = guard & (lsb | sticky);

      
				3'b001: round_up = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				3'b010: round_up = (guard | sticky) & lhs_is_neg;

      
				3'b011: round_up = (guard | sticky) & ~lhs_is_neg;

      
				3'b100: round_up = guard;

      
				default: round_up = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			endcase

      
			if (expo <= 157) begin

      
				int_result = int_result + {31'h00000000, round_up};

      
				result = (lhs_is_neg ? (fmt_unsigned ? 32'h00000000 : -int_result) : int_result);

      
			end

      
			else

      
				result = int_result;

      
			fflags = 1'sb0;

      
			is_invalid = ((expo >= 159) | ((~fmt_unsigned & (expo == 158)) & (~lhs_is_neg | (lhs_is_neg & (mant != 0))))) | ((fmt_unsigned & lhs_is_neg) & ((expo >= 127) | round_up));

      
			if (is_invalid)

      
				fflags[4] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			else if (guard | sticky)

      
				fflags[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

      
	function automatic [5:0] leading_zeros_count;

      
		input reg [31:0] x;

      
		reg [0:1] _sv2v_jump;

      
		begin

      
			_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
				reg [5:0] _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				for (leading_zeros_count = 0; leading_zeros_count <= 31; leading_zeros_count = leading_zeros_count + 1)

      
					if (_sv2v_jump < 2'b10) begin

      
						_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
						if ((x >> (31 - leading_zeros_count)) != 0)

      
							_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
						_sv2v_value_on_break = leading_zeros_count;

      
					end

      
				if (!(_sv2v_jump < 2'b10))

      
					leading_zeros_count = _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				if (_sv2v_jump != 2'b11)

      
					_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			end

      
		end

      
	endfunction

      
	task automatic FP32CVT_I2F;

      
		input reg [31:0] lhs;

      
		input reg fmt_unsigned;

      
		input reg [2:0] rm;

      
		output reg [31:0] result;

      
		output reg [4:0] fflags;

      
		reg is_exact;

      
		reg is_valid;

      
		reg lhs_is_neg;

      
		reg [5:0] lzc;

      
		reg [31:0] abs_lhs;

      
		reg [31:0] shifted_lhs;

      
		reg [7:0] expo;

      
		reg [22:0] mant;

      
		reg round_up;

      
		reg exp_plus_one;

      
		reg lsb;

      
		reg guard;

      
		reg sticky;

      
		begin

      
			lhs_is_neg = ~fmt_unsigned & lhs[31];

      
			abs_lhs = (lhs_is_neg ? -lhs : lhs);

      
			lzc = leading_zeros_count(abs_lhs);

      
			shifted_lhs = abs_lhs << lzc;

      
			mant = shifted_lhs[30:8];

      
			expo = (abs_lhs == {32 {1'sb0}} ? 0 : (8'd127 + 8'd31) - lzc);

      
			{lsb, guard, sticky} = {shifted_lhs[8:7], |shifted_lhs[6:0]};

      
			case (rm)

      
				3'b000: round_up = guard & (lsb | sticky);

      
				3'b001: round_up = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
				3'b010: round_up = (guard | sticky) & lhs_is_neg;

      
				3'b011: round_up = (guard | sticky) & ~lhs_is_neg;

      
				3'b100: round_up = guard;

      
				default: round_up = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			endcase

      
			exp_plus_one = round_up & (&mant);

      
			expo = expo + {7'h00, exp_plus_one};

      
			mant = mant + {22'h000000, round_up};

      
			result = {lhs_is_neg, expo, mant};

      
			fflags = 1'sb0;

      
			if (guard | sticky)

      
				fflags[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		{lhs_sign, lhs_expo, lhs_mant} = lhs;

      
		{rhs_sign, rhs_expo, rhs_mant} = rhs;

      
		lhs_is_zero = (lhs_expo == 8'h00) & (lhs_mant == 0);

      
		rhs_is_zero = (rhs_expo == 8'h00) & (rhs_mant == 0);

      
		lhs_is_inf = (lhs_expo == 8'hff) & (lhs_mant == 0);

      
		rhs_is_inf = (rhs_expo == 8'hff) & (rhs_mant == 0);

      
		lhs_is_nan = (lhs_expo == 8'hff) & (lhs_mant != 0);

      
		rhs_is_nan = (rhs_expo == 8'hff) & (rhs_mant != 0);

      
		lhs_is_snan = lhs_is_nan & (lhs_mant[22] == 0);

      
		rhs_is_snan = rhs_is_nan & (rhs_mant[22] == 0);

      
		lhs_is_subnormal = (lhs_expo == 0) & (lhs_mant != 0);

      
		lhs_is_normal = ~(((lhs_is_zero | lhs_is_inf) | lhs_is_nan) | lhs_is_subnormal);

      
		lhs_is_smaller = (lhs < rhs) ^ (lhs_sign | rhs_sign);

      
		lhs_equal_rhs = (lhs == rhs) | (lhs_is_zero && rhs_is_zero);

      
		fmt_unsigned = |{fpuCode == 5'b10010, fpuCode == 5'b01011};

      
		fflagsOut = 1'sb0;

      
		(* full_case, parallel_case *)

      
		case (fpuCode)

      
			5'b00101: resultOut = {rhs_sign, lhs_expo, lhs_mant};

      
			5'b00110: resultOut = {~rhs_sign, lhs_expo, lhs_mant};

      
			5'b00111: resultOut = {lhs_sign ^ rhs_sign, lhs_expo, lhs_mant};

      
			5'b01000: begin

      
				if (lhs_is_nan & rhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = 32'h7fc00000;

      
				else if (lhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = rhs;

      
				else if (rhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = lhs;

      
				else

      
					resultOut = (lhs_is_smaller ? lhs : rhs);

      
				if (lhs_is_snan || rhs_is_snan)

      
					fflagsOut[4] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			end

      
			5'b01001: begin

      
				if (lhs_is_nan & rhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = 32'h7fc00000;

      
				else if (lhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = rhs;

      
				else if (rhs_is_nan)

      
					resultOut = lhs;

      
				else

	task automatic OpFormatTypes_RISCV_DecodeFPOpFunct3;

      
		output reg [4:0] fpuCode;

      
		input reg [2:0] rv32ffunct3;

      
		input reg [6:0] rv32ffunct7;

      
		input reg [4:0] fcvtfunct5;

      
		case (rv32ffunct7)

      
			7'b0000000: fpuCode = 5'b00000;

      
			7'b0000100: fpuCode = 5'b00001;

      
			7'b0001000: fpuCode = 5'b00010;

      
			7'b0001100: fpuCode = 5'b00011;

      
			7'b0101100: fpuCode = 5'b00100;

      
			7'b0010000:

      
				case (rv32ffunct3[2-:3])

      
					3'b000: fpuCode = 5'b00101;

      
					3'b001: fpuCode = 5'b00110;

      
					3'b010: fpuCode = 5'b00111;

      
					default: fpuCode = 5'b00111;

      
				endcase

      
			7'b0010100:

      
				if (rv32ffunct3[2-:3] == 3'b000)

      
					fpuCode = 5'b01000;

      
				else

      
					fpuCode = 5'b01001;

      
			7'b1100000:

      
				if (fcvtfunct5 == 5'b00000)

      
					fpuCode = 5'b01010;

      
				else

      
					fpuCode = 5'b01011;

      
			7'b1110000:

      
				if (rv32ffunct3[2-:3] == 3'b001)

      
					fpuCode = 5'b10000;

      
				else

      
					fpuCode = 5'b01100;

      
			7'b1010000:

      
				case (rv32ffunct3[2-:3])

      
					3'b010: fpuCode = 5'b01101;

      
					3'b001: fpuCode = 5'b01110;

      
					3'b000: fpuCode = 5'b01111;

      
					default: fpuCode = 5'b01111;

      
				endcase

      
			7'b1101000:

      
				if (fcvtfunct5 == 5'b00000)

      
					fpuCode = 5'b10001;

      
				else

      
					fpuCode = 5'b10010;

      
			7'b1111000: fpuCode = 5'b10011;

      
			default: fpuCode = 5'b10011;

      
		endcase

      
	endtask

	task automatic RISCV_EmitFPOp;

      
		output reg [75:0] opInfo;

		reg readrs2;

		reg [2:0] rm;

			isfR = isf;

      
			rv32fFunct3 = sv2v_cast_3(isfR[14-:3]);

      
			rv32fFunct7 = sv2v_cast_7(isfR[31-:7]);

      
			fcvtfunct5 = sv2v_cast_5(isfR[24-:5]);

      
			rm = sv2v_cast_3(isfR[14-:3]);

      
			OpFormatTypes_RISCV_DecodeFPOpFunct3(fpuCode, rv32fFunct3, rv32fFunct7, fcvtfunct5);

      
			dstFP = !(|{fpuCode == 5'b01010, fpuCode == 5'b01011, fpuCode == 5'b01100, fpuCode == 5'b01101, fpuCode == 5'b01110, fpuCode == 5'b01111, fpuCode == 5'b10000});

      
			rs1FP = !(|{fpuCode == 5'b10001, fpuCode == 5'b10010, fpuCode == 5'b10011});

      
			readrs2 = !(|{fpuCode == 5'b00100, fpuCode == 5'b10001, fpuCode == 5'b10010, fpuCode == 5'b01010, fpuCode == 5'b01011, fpuCode == 5'b10011, fpuCode == 5'b01100, fpuCode == 5'b10000});

      
			opInfo[67] = dstFP;

      
			opInfo[61] = rs1FP;

      
			opInfo[55] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			opInfo[49] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

			opInfo[60-:5] = srcRegNumA;

			opInfo[48-:5] = 1'sb0;

      
			opInfo[38-:3] = rm;

      
			opInfo[43-:5] = fpuCode;

      
			opInfo[35-:21] = 1'sb0;

      
			opInfo[8] = (dstFP || (dstRegNum != MicroOpTypes_ZERO_REGISTER) ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
			opInfo[14-:2] = 2'b00;

      
			opInfo[12-:2] = (readrs2 ? 2'b00 : 2'b01);

      
			opInfo[10-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[72-:2] = 2'b11;

      
			opInfo[70-:3] = ((fpuCode == 5'b00000) || (fpuCode == 5'b00001) ? 3'b000 : (fpuCode == 5'b00010 ? 3'b001 : (fpuCode == 5'b00011 ? 3'b010 : (fpuCode == 5'b00100 ? 3'b011 : 3'b101))));

      
			opInfo[75-:3] = 3'b010;

      
			opInfo[6] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[7] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[0] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[4] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

		output reg [75:0] opInfo;

				3'b010, 3'b110: memOp[23-:2] = 2'b10;

		reg undefined;

      
		begin

      
			isfSystem = isf;

      
			opFunct3 = sv2v_cast_3(isfSystem[14-:3]);

      
			opFunct12 = sv2v_cast_12(isfSystem[31-:12]);

      
			systemOp[52] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			systemOp[46] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			systemOp[40] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

				case (sv2v_cast_12(isfSystem[31-:12]))

      
					12'b000000000000: systemOp[34-:3] = 3'b000;

      
					12'b000000000001: systemOp[34-:3] = 3'b001;

			opInfo[8] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[14-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[12-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[10-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[75-:3] = 3'b010;

      
			opInfo[4] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			opInfo[6] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[7] = undefined;

      
			opInfo[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

	task automatic RISCV_DecodeSystem;

      
		output reg [227:0] microOps;

      
		output reg [4:0] insnInfo;

      
		input reg [31:0] isf;

      
		reg [75:0] opInfo;

      
		reg [1:0] mid;

      
		begin

      
			if (sv2v_cast_3(isf[14-:3]) == 3'b000)

      
				RISCV_EmitSystemOp(opInfo, isf);

      
			else

      
				RISCV_EmitCSR_Op(opInfo, isf);

      
			mid = 0;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_13

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < MicroOpTypes_MICRO_OP_MAX_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
					EmitInvalidOp(microOps[i * 76+:76]);

      
			end

      
			microOps[76+:76] = ModifyMicroOp(opInfo, mid, BasicTypes_FALSE, BasicTypes_TRUE);

      
			insnInfo[4] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[3] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[2] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[1] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

      
	task automatic RISCV_EmitUTypeInst;

      
		output reg [75:0] opInfo;

      
		input reg [31:0] isf;

      
		input reg [4:0] srcRegNumA;

      
		input reg [4:0] srcRegNumB;

      
		input reg [4:0] dstRegNum;

      
		input reg unsupported;

      
		reg [31:0] isfU;

      
		reg [29:0] intOperandImmShift;

      
		begin

      
			isfU = isf;

      
			opInfo[67] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[61] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[55] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[66-:5] = dstRegNum;

      
			opInfo[60-:5] = srcRegNumA;

      
			opInfo[54-:5] = srcRegNumB;

      
			opInfo[45] = 1'b1;

      
			intOperandImmShift[29-:5] = 1'sb0;

      
			intOperandImmShift[24-:2] = 2'b11;

      
			intOperandImmShift[22] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			intOperandImmShift[21-:20] = isfU[31-:20];

      
			intOperandImmShift[1-:2] = 2'b11;

      
			opInfo[44-:BasicTypes_RISCV_SHIFTER_WIDTH] = intOperandImmShift;

      
			opInfo[49-:4] = 4'b0000;

      
			opInfo[8] = (dstRegNum != MicroOpTypes_ZERO_REGISTER ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
			opInfo[14-:2] = (isf[6-:7] == 7'b0010111 ? 2'b10 : 2'b00);

      
			opInfo[12-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[10-:2] = 2'b01;

      
			opInfo[72-:2] = 2'b00;

      
			opInfo[70-:3] = 3'b000;

      
			opInfo[75-:3] = 3'b010;

      
			opInfo[6] = unsupported;

      
			opInfo[7] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[0] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			opInfo[4] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

      
	task automatic RISCV_DecodeUTypeInst;

      
		output reg [227:0] microOps;

      
		output reg [4:0] insnInfo;

      
		input reg [31:0] isf;

      
		reg [75:0] intOp;

      
		reg [1:0] mid;

      
		begin

      
			RISCV_EmitUTypeInst(intOp, isf, 0, 0, isf[11-:5], BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
			mid = 0;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_14

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < MicroOpTypes_MICRO_OP_MAX_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
					EmitInvalidOp(microOps[i * 76+:76]);

      
			end

      
			microOps[76+:76] = ModifyMicroOp(intOp, mid, BasicTypes_FALSE, BasicTypes_TRUE);

      
			mid = mid + 1;

      
			insnInfo[4] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[3] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[2] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[1] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			insnInfo[0] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
	endtask

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		isf = insn;

      
		rv32mFunct7 = sv2v_cast_7(isf[31-:7]);

      
		zbaFunct7 = sv2v_cast_7(isf[31-:7]);

      
		zicondFunct7 = sv2v_cast_7(isf[31-:7]);

      
		insnInfo[4] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		insnInfo[3] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		insnInfo[2] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		insnInfo[1] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		insnInfo[0] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		case (isf[6-:7])

      
			7'b0000011, 7'b0100011:

      
				RISCV_DecodeMemOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1100011:

      
				RISCV_DecodeBranch(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1100111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeJALR(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1101111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeJAL(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b0010011:

      
				RISCV_DecodeOpImm(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b0110011:

      
				if (rv32mFunct7 == 7'b0000001)

      
					RISCV_DecodeComplexOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
				else

      
					RISCV_DecodeOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b0010111, 7'b0110111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeUTypeInst(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b0001111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeMiscMem(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1110011:

      
				RISCV_DecodeSystem(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b0000111, 7'b0100111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeFPMemOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1010011:

      
				RISCV_DecodeFPOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			7'b1000011, 7'b1000111, 7'b1001011, 7'b1001111:

      
				RISCV_DecodeFPFMAOp(microOps, insnInfo, insn);

      
			default:

      
				RISCV_DecodeIllegal(microOps, insnInfo, insn, illegalPC);

      
		endcase

      
		undefined = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_15

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < MicroOpTypes_MICRO_OP_MAX_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				if (microOps[(i * 76) + 7] || microOps[(i * 76) + 6])

      
					undefined = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
		if (undefined || illegalPC)

      
			RISCV_DecodeIllegal(microOps, insnInfo, insn, illegalPC);

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module DecodedBranchResolver (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	stall,

      
	decodeComplete,

      
	insnValidIn,

      
	isf,

      
	brPredIn,

      
	pc,

      
	insnInfo,

      
	insnValidOut,

      
	insnFlushed,

      
	insnFlushTriggering,

      
	flushTriggered,

      
	brPredOut,

      
	recoveredPC

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire stall;

      
	input wire decodeComplete;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH = BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	input wire [0:1] insnValidIn;

      
	input wire [63:0] isf;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_BRANCH_GLOBAL_HISTORY_BIT_WIDTH = 10;

      
	localparam FetchUnitTypes_BRANCH_GLOBAL_HISTORY_BIT_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_BRANCH_GLOBAL_HISTORY_BIT_WIDTH;

      
	localparam FetchUnitTypes_PHT_ENTRY_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH = 19;

      
	input wire [63:0] brPredIn;

      
	input wire [37:0] pc;

      
	input wire [9:0] insnInfo;

      
	output reg [0:1] insnValidOut;

      
	output reg [0:1] insnFlushed;

      
	output reg [0:1] insnFlushTriggering;

      
	output reg flushTriggered;

      
	output reg [63:0] brPredOut;

      
	output reg [18:0] recoveredPC;

      
	parameter RAS_ENTRY_NUM = 4;

      
	reg [18:0] ras [0:RAS_ENTRY_NUM - 1];

      
	reg [18:0] nextRAS;

      
	reg pushRAS;

      
	reg popRAS;

      
	reg [$clog2(RAS_ENTRY_NUM) - 1:0] rasPtr;

      
	reg [$clog2(RAS_ENTRY_NUM) - 1:0] nextRAS_Ptr;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < RAS_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
					ras[i] <= 1'sb0;

      
			end

      
			rasPtr <= 1'sb0;

      
		end

      
		else if (!stall && decodeComplete) begin

      
			if (pushRAS)

      
				ras[nextRAS_Ptr] <= nextRAS;

      
			rasPtr <= nextRAS_Ptr;

      
		end

      
	reg [18:0] decodedPC [0:1];

      
	reg [18:0] nextPC [0:1];

      
	reg [31:0] isfU [0:1];

      
	reg addrCheck;

      
	reg addrIncorrect;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH_BIT_SIZE = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH_BIT_SIZE = BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH_BIT_SIZE;

      
	reg [0:0] addrCheckLane;

      
	reg [1:0] brTargetType [0:1];

      
	reg addrMismatch [0:1];

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_BYTE_WIDTH = 8;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_INSN_WIDTH = 32;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_INSN_BYTE_WIDTH = 4;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_ADDR_WIDTH = 32;

      
	localparam OpFormatTypes_BR_DISP_WIDTH = 20;

      
	function automatic [31:0] OpFormatTypes_ExtendBranchDisplacement;

      
		input reg [19:0] brDisp;

      
		OpFormatTypes_ExtendBranchDisplacement = {{11 {brDisp[19]}}, brDisp, 1'b0};

      
	endfunction

      
	function automatic [19:0] OpFormatTypes_GetBranchDisplacement;

      
		input reg [31:0] isfBr;

      
		OpFormatTypes_GetBranchDisplacement = {{9 {isfBr[31]}}, isfBr[7], isfBr[30-:6], isfBr[11-:4]};

      
	endfunction

      
	function automatic [19:0] OpFormatTypes_GetJAL_Target;

      
		input reg [31:0] isfJAL;

      
		OpFormatTypes_GetJAL_Target = {isfJAL[31], isfJAL[19-:8], isfJAL[20], isfJAL[30-:10]};

      
	endfunction

      
	always @(*) begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
		reg [0:1] _sv2v_jump;

      
		_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		flushTriggered = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		recoveredPC = 1'sb0;

      
		pushRAS = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		popRAS = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		nextRAS = 0;

      
		nextRAS_Ptr = rasPtr;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_3

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					insnValidOut[i] = insnValidIn[i];

      
					insnFlushed[i] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
					insnFlushTriggering[i] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
					brPredOut[(1 - i) * 32+:32] = brPredIn[i * 32+:32];

      
					isfU[i] = isf[i * 32+:32];

      
				end

      
		end

      
		addrCheck = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		addrIncorrect = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		addrCheckLane = 1'sb0;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_4

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				if (insnInfo[(i * 5) + 1])

      
					brTargetType[i] = 2'd1;

      
				else if (insnInfo[(i * 5) + 4])

      
					brTargetType[i] = 2'd2;

      
				else if (insnInfo[i * 5])

      
					brTargetType[i] = 2'd3;

      
				else

      
					brTargetType[i] = 2'd0;

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_5

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_6

      
				reg signed [31:0] _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
					if (_sv2v_jump < 2'b10) begin

      
						_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
						if (!insnValidIn[i])

      
							_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
						if (_sv2v_jump == 2'b00) begin

      
							if (!insnInfo[(i * 5) + 4] && brPredIn[(i * 32) + 12]) begin

      
								addrCheckLane = i;

      
								addrCheck = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								addrIncorrect = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
							end

      
							else if ((brTargetType[i] == 2'd1) && ((isfU[i][6-:7] == 7'b1101111) || brPredIn[(i * 32) + 12])) begin

      
								pushRAS = insnInfo[(i * 5) + 3];

      
								addrCheckLane = i;

      
								addrCheck = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
							end

      
							else if (brTargetType[i] == 2'd2) begin

      
								pushRAS = insnInfo[(i * 5) + 3];

      
								popRAS = insnInfo[(i * 5) + 2];

      
								if (popRAS) begin

      
									addrCheckLane = i;

      
									addrCheck = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
									_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
								end

      
								else if (pushRAS) begin

      
									addrCheckLane = i;

      
									_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
								end

      
							end

      
							else if (brTargetType[i] == 2'd3) begin

      
								addrCheckLane = i;

      
								addrCheck = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								addrIncorrect = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
							end

      
						end

      
						_sv2v_value_on_break = i;

      
					end

      
				if (!(_sv2v_jump < 2'b10))

      
					i = _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
				if (_sv2v_jump != 2'b11)

      
					_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			end

      
		end

      
		if (_sv2v_jump == 2'b00) begin

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_7

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
					begin

      
						nextPC[i] = pc[(1 - i) * MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH+:MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH] + BasicTypes_INSN_BYTE_WIDTH;

      
						if (brTargetType[i] == 2'd1) begin

      
							if (isfU[i][6-:7] == 7'b1101111)

      
								decodedPC[i] = pc[(1 - i) * MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH+:MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH] + OpFormatTypes_ExtendBranchDisplacement(OpFormatTypes_GetJAL_Target(isfU[i]));

      
							else

      
								decodedPC[i] = pc[(1 - i) * MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH+:MemoryMapTypes_PC_WIDTH] + OpFormatTypes_ExtendBranchDisplacement(OpFormatTypes_GetBranchDisplacement(isfU[i]));

      
						end

      
						else if (brTargetType[i] == 2'd2)

      
							decodedPC[i] = ras[rasPtr];

      
						else

      
							decodedPC[i] = nextPC[i];

      
					end

      
			end

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_8

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
					addrMismatch[i] = brPredIn[(i * 32) + 31-:19] != decodedPC[i];

      
			end

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_9

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_10

      
					reg signed [31:0] _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
					for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
						if (_sv2v_jump < 2'b10) begin

      
							_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
							if (((addrMismatch[i] && addrCheck) || addrIncorrect) && (addrCheckLane == i)) begin

      
								flushTriggered = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								brPredOut[((1 - i) * 32) + 31-:19] = decodedPC[i];

      
								brPredOut[((1 - i) * 32) + 12] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
							end

      
							_sv2v_value_on_break = i;

      
						end

      
					if (!(_sv2v_jump < 2'b10))

      
						i = _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
					if (_sv2v_jump != 2'b11)

      
						_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
				end

      
			end

      
			if (_sv2v_jump == 2'b00) begin

      
				recoveredPC = decodedPC[addrCheckLane];

      
				nextRAS = nextPC[addrCheckLane];

      
				if (pushRAS)

      
					nextRAS_Ptr = rasPtr + 1;

      
				else if (popRAS)

      
					nextRAS_Ptr = rasPtr - 1;

      
				else

      
					nextRAS_Ptr = rasPtr;

      
				if (flushTriggered) begin

      
					begin : sv2v_autoblock_11

      
						reg signed [31:0] i;

      
						for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DECODE_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
							if (i > addrCheckLane) begin

      
								insnValidOut[i] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
								insnFlushed[i] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
							end

      
					end

      
					insnFlushTriggering[addrCheckLane] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
				end

      
			end

      
		end

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module ReadyBitTable (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	rstStart,

      
	wakeup,

      
	wakeupDstValid,

      
	wakeupDstRegNum,

      
	dispatch,

      
	dispatchedDstValid,

      
	dispatchedDstRegNum,

      
	dispatchedSrcValid,

      
	dispatchedSrcRegNum,

      
	dispatchedSrcReady

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter SRC_OP_NUM = 2;

      
	parameter REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH = 5;

      
	parameter ENTRY_NUM = 32;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire rstStart;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH = 5;

      
	input wire [0:4] wakeup;

      
	input wire [0:4] wakeupDstValid;

      
	input wire [(5 * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] wakeupDstRegNum;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH = BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	input wire [0:1] dispatch;

      
	input wire [0:1] dispatchedDstValid;

      
	input wire [(2 * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] dispatchedDstRegNum;

      
	input wire [(2 * SRC_OP_NUM) - 1:0] dispatchedSrcValid;

      
	input wire [((2 * SRC_OP_NUM) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] dispatchedSrcRegNum;

      
	output reg [(2 * SRC_OP_NUM) - 1:0] dispatchedSrcReady;

      
	localparam READY_WRITE_NUM = 7;

      
	localparam READY_READ_NUM = BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH * SRC_OP_NUM;

      
	reg [0:6] readyWE;

      
	reg [0:6] readyWV;

      
	reg [(7 * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] readyWA;

      
	wire [0:READY_READ_NUM - 1] readyRV;

      
	reg [(READY_READ_NUM * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] readyRA;

      
	DistributedMultiPortRAM #(

      
		.ENTRY_NUM(1 << REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH),

      
		.ENTRY_BIT_SIZE(1),

      
		.READ_NUM(READY_READ_NUM),

      
		.WRITE_NUM(READY_WRITE_NUM)

      
	) radyBitTable(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.we(readyWE),

      
		.wa(readyWA),

      
		.wv(readyWV),

      
		.ra(readyRA),

      
		.rv(readyRV)

      
	);

      
	reg [REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] resetIndex;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rstStart)

      
			resetIndex <= 0;

      
		else

      
			resetIndex <= resetIndex + 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					readyWA[(6 - i) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] = wakeupDstRegNum[(4 - i) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH];

      
					readyWV[i] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
					readyWE[i] = wakeup[i] && wakeupDstValid[i];

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					readyWA[(6 - (i + SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] = dispatchedDstRegNum[(1 - i) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH];

      
					readyWV[i + SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
					readyWE[i + SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH] = dispatch[i] && dispatchedDstValid[i];

      
				end

      
		end

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_3

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < READY_WRITE_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
					readyWE[i] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			end

      
			readyWA[6 * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] = resetIndex;

      
			readyWV[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			readyWE[0] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_4

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_5

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						begin

      
							readyRA[((READY_READ_NUM - 1) - ((i * SRC_OP_NUM) + j)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] = dispatchedSrcRegNum[(((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH];

      
							if (dispatchedSrcValid[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)] == BasicTypes_FALSE)

      
								dispatchedSrcReady[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
							else begin

      
								dispatchedSrcReady[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)] = readyRV[(i * SRC_OP_NUM) + j];

      
								begin : sv2v_autoblock_6

      
									reg signed [31:0] k;

      
									for (k = 0; k < SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH; k = k + 1)

      
										if ((wakeup[k] && wakeupDstValid[k]) && (wakeupDstRegNum[(4 - k) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] == dispatchedSrcRegNum[(((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH]))

      
											dispatchedSrcReady[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
								end

      
								begin : sv2v_autoblock_7

      
									reg signed [31:0] k;

      
									for (k = 0; k < i; k = k + 1)

      
										if ((dispatch[k] && dispatchedDstValid[k]) && (dispatchedSrcRegNum[(((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] == dispatchedDstRegNum[(1 - k) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH]))

      
											dispatchedSrcReady[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
								end

      
							end

      
						end

      
				end

      
		end

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module SourceCAM (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	dispatch,

      
	dispatchPtr,

      
	dispatchedSrcRegNum,

      
	dispatchedSrcReady,

      
	wakeup,

      
	wakeupDstValid,

      
	wakeupDstRegNum,

      
	opReady

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter SRC_OP_NUM = 1;

      
	parameter REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH = 1;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH = BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	input wire [0:1] dispatch;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM = 16;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM = MicroArchConf_CONF_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH = 4;

      
	input wire [7:0] dispatchPtr;

      
	input wire [((2 * SRC_OP_NUM) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] dispatchedSrcRegNum;

      
	input wire [(2 * SRC_OP_NUM) - 1:0] dispatchedSrcReady;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH = 5;

      
	input wire [0:4] wakeup;

      
	input wire [0:4] wakeupDstValid;

      
	input wire [(5 * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] wakeupDstRegNum;

      
	output reg [15:0] opReady;

      
	reg srcReady [0:15][0:SRC_OP_NUM - 1];

      
	reg nextSrcReady [0:15][0:SRC_OP_NUM - 1];

      
	reg [REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] srcRegNum [0:15][0:SRC_OP_NUM - 1];

      
	reg match [0:15][0:SRC_OP_NUM - 1];

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	always @(posedge clk) begin

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						srcReady[i][j] <= (rst ? BasicTypes_FALSE : nextSrcReady[i][j]);

      
				end

      
		end

      
		if (rst) begin : sv2v_autoblock_3

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_4

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						srcRegNum[i][j] <= 0;

      
				end

      
		end

      
		else begin : sv2v_autoblock_5

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				if (dispatch[i]) begin : sv2v_autoblock_6

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						srcRegNum[dispatchPtr[(1 - i) * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH]][j] <= dispatchedSrcRegNum[(((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH];

      
				end

      
		end

      
	end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_7

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_8

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						begin

      
							match[i][j] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
							begin : sv2v_autoblock_9

      
								reg signed [31:0] k;

      
								for (k = 0; k < SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH; k = k + 1)

      
									if (wakeup[k] && wakeupDstValid[k])

      
										match[i][j] = match[i][j] || (wakeupDstRegNum[(4 - k) * REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:REG_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] == srcRegNum[i][j]);

      
							end

      
						end

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_10

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					opReady[i] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
					begin : sv2v_autoblock_11

      
						reg signed [31:0] j;

      
						for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
							opReady[i] = opReady[i] && (match[i][j] || srcReady[i][j]);

      
					end

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_12

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_13

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						nextSrcReady[i][j] = srcReady[i][j] || match[i][j];

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_14

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_15

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SRC_OP_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						if (dispatch[i])

      
							nextSrcReady[dispatchPtr[(1 - i) * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH]][j] = dispatchedSrcReady[((1 - i) * SRC_OP_NUM) + ((SRC_OP_NUM - 1) - j)];

      
				end

      
		end

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module ProducerMatrix (

      
	clk,

      
	dispatch,

      
	dispatchedSrcRegReady,

      
	dispatchedSrcRegPtr,

      
	dependStoreBitVector,

      
	dispatchPtr,

      
	wakeupDstVector,

      
	opReady

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH = BasicTypes_FETCH_WIDTH;

      
	input wire [0:1] dispatch;

      
	localparam MicroOpTypes_MICRO_OP_SOURCE_REG_NUM = 3;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_SRC_REG_NUM = MicroOpTypes_MICRO_OP_SOURCE_REG_NUM;

      
	input wire [5:0] dispatchedSrcRegReady;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM = 16;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM = MicroArchConf_CONF_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH = 4;

      
	input wire [23:0] dispatchedSrcRegPtr;

      
	input [31:0] dependStoreBitVector;

      
	input wire [7:0] dispatchPtr;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_STORE_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_STORE_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_STORE_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_COMPLEX_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_FP_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = 2;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_INT_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = 1;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH = MicroArchConf_CONF_LOAD_ISSUE_WIDTH;

      
	localparam SchedulerTypes_WAKEUP_WIDTH = 5;

      
	input wire [95:0] wakeupDstVector;

      
	output reg [0:15] opReady;

      
	reg [255:0] nextMatrix;

      
	reg [255:0] matrix;

      
	always @(posedge clk) matrix <= nextMatrix;

      
	reg [31:0] dispatchVector;

      
	reg [15:0] wakeupVector;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		nextMatrix = matrix;

      
		wakeupVector = 1'sb0;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] w;

      
			for (w = 0; w < 6; w = w + 1)

      
				wakeupVector = wakeupVector | wakeupDstVector[(5 - w) * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM];

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_3

      
					reg signed [31:0] j;

      
					for (j = 0; j < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
						nextMatrix[(i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM) + j] = (wakeupVector[j] ? BasicTypes_FALSE : nextMatrix[(i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM) + j]);

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_4

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; i = i + 1)

      
				opReady[i] = !(|nextMatrix[i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM]);

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_5

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					dispatchVector[i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM] = 1'sb0;

      
					begin : sv2v_autoblock_6

      
						reg signed [31:0] j;

      
						for (j = 0; j < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_SRC_REG_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
							if (!dispatchedSrcRegReady[((1 - i) * 3) + (2 - j)])

      
								dispatchVector[(i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM) + dispatchedSrcRegPtr[((i * 3) + j) * 4+:4]] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
					end

      
					begin : sv2v_autoblock_7

      
						reg signed [31:0] j;

      
						for (j = 0; j < SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM; j = j + 1)

      
							if (dependStoreBitVector[((1 - i) * 16) + j])

      
								dispatchVector[(i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM) + j] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
					end

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_8

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < BasicTypes_DISPATCH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				if (dispatch[i])

      
					nextMatrix[dispatchPtr[(1 - i) * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM_BIT_WIDTH] * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM] = dispatchVector[i * SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM+:SchedulerTypes_ISSUE_QUEUE_ENTRY_NUM];

      
		end

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_ICACHE_LINE_BYTE_NUM = 8;

	input wire [10:0] writeTag;

      
	localparam CacheSystemTypes_ICACHE_LINE_BIT_WIDTH = 64;

      
	input wire [63:0] writeLineData;

      
	input wire [7:0] readIndex;

      
	input wire [10:0] readTag;

      
	output reg [63:0] readLineData;

      
	output reg hit;

      
	output reg valid;

      
	reg weWay;

      
	reg [7:0] rstIndex;

      
	reg [7:0] writeWayIndex;

      
	wire [75:0] readWayData;

      
	reg [75:0] writeWayData;

      
	localparam CacheSystemTypes_ICACHE_INDEX_NUM = 256;

      
	BlockDualPortRAM #(

      
		.ENTRY_NUM(CacheSystemTypes_ICACHE_INDEX_NUM),

      
		.ENTRY_BIT_SIZE(76)

      
	) tagValidArray(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.we(weWay),

      
		.wa(writeWayIndex),

		.ra(readIndex),

      
		.rv(readWayData)

      
	);

	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			weWay = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
			writeWayIndex = rstIndex;

      
			writeWayData[11] = BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			weWay = we;

      
			writeWayIndex = writeIndex;

      
			writeWayData[11] = BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
		writeWayData[10-:CacheSystemTypes_ICACHE_TAG_BIT_WIDTH] = writeTag;

      
		writeWayData[75-:64] = writeLineData;

      
		readLineData = readWayData[75-:64];

      
		valid = readWayData[11];

      
		hit = valid && (readWayData[10-:CacheSystemTypes_ICACHE_TAG_BIT_WIDTH] == readTag);

      
	end

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rstStart)

      
			rstIndex <= 1'sb0;

      
		else

      
			rstIndex <= rstIndex + 1;

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;
