	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	memAccessAddr,

      
	memAccessWriteData,

      
	memAccessRE,

      
	memAccessWE,

      
	memAccessBusy,

      
	nextMemReadSerial,

      
	nextMemWriteSerial,

      
	memReadDataReady,

      
	memReadData,

      
	memReadSerial,

      
	memAccessResponse

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter INIT_HEX_FILE = "";

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_ADDR_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] memAccessAddr;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ENTRY_BIT_NUM = 64;

      
	input wire [63:0] memAccessWriteData;

      
	input wire memAccessRE;

      
	input wire memAccessWE;

      
	output reg memAccessBusy;

      
	localparam MicroArchConf_CONF_DCACHE_MSHR_NUM = 2;

      
	localparam CacheSystemTypes_MSHR_NUM = MicroArchConf_CONF_DCACHE_MSHR_NUM;

      
	localparam CacheSystemTypes_MEM_ACCESS_SERIAL_BIT_SIZE = 2;

      
	output reg [1:0] nextMemReadSerial;

      
	localparam CacheSystemTypes_MEM_WRITE_SERIAL_BIT_SIZE = 1;

      
	output reg [0:0] nextMemWriteSerial;

      
	output reg memReadDataReady;

      
	output reg [63:0] memReadData;

      
	output reg [1:0] memReadSerial;

      
	output reg [1:0] memAccessResponse;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_READ_PIPELINE_DEPTH = 5;

      
	reg [68:0] memPipeReg [0:4];

      
	reg [68:0] nextMemPipeReg;

      
	reg [1:0] nextNextMemReadSerial;

      
	reg [0:0] nextNextMemWriteSerial;

      
	reg memReadAccessAck;

      
	reg prevMemReadAccessAck;

      
	reg memWriteAccessAck;

      
	reg prevMemWriteAccessAck;

      
	reg [1:0] processLatencyCount;

      
	reg [1:0] nextProcessLatencyCount;

      
	wire [63:0] ramReadData;

      
	reg memoryWE;

      
	reg [31:0] memoryWA;

      
	reg [63:0] memoryWV;

      
	reg [31:0] memoryRA;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_BYTE_WIDTH = 8;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ENTRY_BYTE_NUM = 8;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_LSB = 3;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_BIT_SIZE = 18;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_MSB = 17;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_INDEX_BIT_WIDTH = 15;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ENTRY_NUM = 32768;

      
	InitializedBlockRAM #(

      
		.ENTRY_NUM(MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ENTRY_NUM),

      
		.INIT_HEX_FILE(INIT_HEX_FILE),

      
		.ENTRY_BIT_SIZE(MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ENTRY_BIT_NUM)

      
	) body(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.we(memoryWE),

      
		.wa(memoryWA[MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_MSB:MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_LSB]),

      
		.wv(memoryWV),

      
		.ra(memoryRA[MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_MSB:MemoryTypes_MEMORY_ADDR_LSB]),

      
		.rv(ramReadData)

      
	);

      
	reg pushRequestQueue;

      
	reg [101:0] pushedData;

      
	wire hasRequest;

      
	reg hasRequestReg;

      
	wire [101:0] requestData;

      
	reg [101:0] requestDataReg;

      
	MemoryLatencySimulator memReqQueue(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.rst(rst),

      
		.push(pushRequestQueue),

      
		.pushedData(pushedData),

      
		.hasRequest(hasRequest),

      
		.requestData(requestData)

      
	);

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			processLatencyCount <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			prevMemReadAccessAck <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			prevMemWriteAccessAck <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			nextMemReadSerial <= 1'sb0;

      
			nextMemWriteSerial <= 1'sb0;

      
			requestDataReg <= 1'sb0;

      
			hasRequestReg <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < MemoryTypes_MEMORY_READ_PIPELINE_DEPTH; i = i + 1)

      
					memPipeReg[i] <= 1'sb0;

      
			end

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			processLatencyCount <= nextProcessLatencyCount;

      
			prevMemReadAccessAck <= memReadAccessAck;

      
			prevMemWriteAccessAck <= memWriteAccessAck;

      
			nextMemReadSerial <= nextNextMemReadSerial;

      
			nextMemWriteSerial <= nextNextMemWriteSerial;

      
			requestDataReg <= requestData;

      
			hasRequestReg <= hasRequest;

      
			memPipeReg[0] <= nextMemPipeReg;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1)

      
					memPipeReg[i + 1] <= memPipeReg[i];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_READ_PROCESS_LATENCY = 2;

      
	localparam MemoryTypes_MEMORY_WRITE_PROCESS_LATENCY = 2;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (memAccessBusy)

      
			nextProcessLatencyCount = processLatencyCount - 1;

      
		else if (memAccessRE)

      
			nextProcessLatencyCount = MemoryTypes_MEMORY_READ_PROCESS_LATENCY;

      
		else if (memAccessWE)

      
			nextProcessLatencyCount = MemoryTypes_MEMORY_WRITE_PROCESS_LATENCY;

      
		else

      
			nextProcessLatencyCount = 0;

      
		if (prevMemReadAccessAck)

      
			nextNextMemReadSerial = nextMemReadSerial + 1;

      
		else

      
			nextNextMemReadSerial = nextMemReadSerial;

      
		if (prevMemWriteAccessAck)

      
			nextNextMemWriteSerial = nextMemWriteSerial + 1;

      
		else

      
			nextNextMemWriteSerial = nextMemWriteSerial;

      
		memReadAccessAck = (memAccessRE && !memAccessBusy ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		memWriteAccessAck = (memAccessWE && !memAccessBusy ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		nextMemPipeReg[68] = (hasRequestReg ? requestDataReg[101] : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		nextMemPipeReg[67-:64] = ramReadData;

      
		nextMemPipeReg[3-:2] = requestDataReg[3-:2];

      
		nextMemPipeReg[1-:1] = requestDataReg[1-:1];

      
		nextMemPipeReg[0] = requestDataReg[0];

      
		pushRequestQueue = memReadAccessAck || memWriteAccessAck;

      
		pushedData[101] = memAccessRE;

      
		pushedData[100] = memAccessWE;

      
		pushedData[99-:32] = memAccessAddr;

      
		pushedData[67-:64] = memAccessWriteData;

      
		pushedData[3-:2] = nextNextMemReadSerial;

      
		pushedData[1-:1] = nextNextMemWriteSerial;

      
		pushedData[0] = memWriteAccessAck;

      
		memoryWE = (hasRequest ? requestData[100] : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		memoryWA = requestData[99-:32];

      
		memoryWV = requestData[67-:64];

      
		memoryRA = requestData[99-:32];

      
	end

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		memReadDataReady = memPipeReg[4][68];

      
		memReadData = memPipeReg[4][67-:64];

      
		memAccessBusy = (processLatencyCount != 0 ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		memReadSerial = memPipeReg[4][3-:2];

      
		memAccessResponse[1] = memPipeReg[1][0];

      
		memAccessResponse[0-:CacheSystemTypes_MEM_WRITE_SERIAL_BIT_SIZE] = memPipeReg[1][1-:1];

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module ResetController (

      
	clk,

      
	rstTrigger,

      
	locked,

      
	rst,

      
	rstStart

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter CYCLE_OF_RESET_SEQUENCE = 10000;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rstTrigger;

      
	input wire locked;

      
	output reg rst;

      
	output reg rstStart;

      
	reg [$clog2(CYCLE_OF_RESET_SEQUENCE):0] count;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(posedge clk or posedge rstTrigger)

      
		if (rstTrigger || !locked) begin

      
			count <= 0;

      
			rst <= BasicTypes_TRUE;

      
		end

      
		else if (rst) begin

      
			count <= count + 1;

      
			rst <= (count >= CYCLE_OF_RESET_SEQUENCE ? BasicTypes_FALSE : BasicTypes_TRUE);

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			count <= 0;

      
			rst <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		rstStart = (rst && (count == 0) ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module FlipFlop (

      
	out,

      
	in,

      
	clk,

      
	rst

      
);

      
	parameter FF_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter RESET_VALUE = 0;

      
	output wire [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] out;

      
	input wire [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] in;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	reg [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] body;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst == 1)

      
			body <= RESET_VALUE;

      
		else

      
			body <= in;

      
	assign out = body;

      
endmodule

      
module FlipFlopWE (

      
	out,

      
	in,

      
	we,

      
	clk,

      
	rst

      
);

      
	parameter FF_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter RESET_VALUE = 0;

      
	output wire [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] out;

      
	input wire [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] in;

      
	input wire we;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	reg [FF_WIDTH - 1:0] body;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst == 1)

      
			body <= RESET_VALUE;

      
		else if (we)

      
			body <= in;

      
		else

      
			body <= body;

      
	assign out = body;

      
endmodule

      
module FreeList (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	push,

      
	pop,

      
	pushedData,

      
	full,

      
	empty,

      
	headData

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter SIZE = 1;

      
	parameter ENTRY_WIDTH = 1;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire push;

      
	input wire pop;

      
	input wire [ENTRY_WIDTH - 1:0] pushedData;

      
	output wire full;

      
	output wire empty;

      
	output reg [ENTRY_WIDTH - 1:0] headData;

      
	localparam BIT_WIDTH = $clog2(SIZE);

      
	wire [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] headPtr;

      
	wire [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] tailPtr;

      
	QueuePointer #(

      
		.SIZE(SIZE),

      
		.INITIAL_HEAD_PTR(0),

      
		.INITIAL_TAIL_PTR(0),

      
		.INITIAL_COUNT(SIZE)

      
	) pointer(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.rst(rst),

      
		.push(push),

      
		.pop(pop),

      
		.full(full),

      
		.empty(empty),

      
		.headPtr(headPtr),

      
		.tailPtr(tailPtr)

      
	);

      
	reg [ENTRY_WIDTH - 1:0] freeList [SIZE - 1:0];

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < SIZE; i = i + 1)

      
				freeList[i] <= i;

      
		end

      
		else if (push)

      
			freeList[tailPtr] <= pushedData;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		headData = freeList[headPtr];

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module MultiWidthFreeList (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	rstStart,

      
	push,

      
	pop,

      
	pushedData,

      
	count,

      
	poppedData

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter SIZE = 16;

      
	parameter ENTRY_BIT_SIZE = 4;

      
	parameter PUSH_WIDTH = 4;

      
	parameter POP_WIDTH = 4;

      
	parameter INITIAL_LENGTH = SIZE;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire rstStart;

      
	input wire [0:PUSH_WIDTH - 1] push;

      
	input wire [0:POP_WIDTH - 1] pop;

      
	input wire [(PUSH_WIDTH * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] pushedData;

      
	output wire [$clog2(SIZE):0] count;

      
	output reg [(POP_WIDTH * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] poppedData;

      
	localparam INDEX_BIT_SIZE = $clog2(SIZE);

      
	wire [INDEX_BIT_SIZE - 1:0] headPtr;

      
	wire [INDEX_BIT_SIZE - 1:0] tailPtr;

      
	reg [$clog2(PUSH_WIDTH):0] pushCount;

      
	reg [$clog2(POP_WIDTH):0] popCount;

      
	MultiWidthQueuePointer #(

      
		.SIZE(SIZE),

      
		.INITIAL_HEAD_PTR(0),

      
		.INITIAL_TAIL_PTR(INITIAL_LENGTH),

      
		.INITIAL_COUNT(INITIAL_LENGTH),

      
		.PUSH_WIDTH(PUSH_WIDTH),

      
		.POP_WIDTH(POP_WIDTH)

      
	) queuePointer(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.rst(rst),

      
		.push(pushCount != 0),

      
		.pop(popCount != 0),

      
		.pushCount(pushCount),

      
		.popCount(popCount),

      
		.headPtr(headPtr),

      
		.tailPtr(tailPtr),

      
		.count(count)

      
	);

      
	reg [0:PUSH_WIDTH - 1] we;

      
	reg [(PUSH_WIDTH * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] wv;

      
	reg [(PUSH_WIDTH * INDEX_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] wa;

      
	wire [(POP_WIDTH * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] rv;

      
	reg [(POP_WIDTH * INDEX_BIT_SIZE) - 1:0] ra;

      
	reg [INDEX_BIT_SIZE - 1:0] rstIndex;

      
	DistributedMultiBankRAM #(

      
		.ENTRY_NUM(SIZE),

      
		.ENTRY_BIT_SIZE(ENTRY_BIT_SIZE),

      
		.READ_NUM(POP_WIDTH),

      
		.WRITE_NUM(PUSH_WIDTH)

      
	) freeList(

      
		.clk(clk),

      
		.wa(wa),

      
		.we(we),

      
		.wv(wv),

      
		.ra(ra),

      
		.rv(rv)

      
	);

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rstStart)

      
			rstIndex <= 0;

      
		else if (rstIndex >= (SIZE - PUSH_WIDTH))

      
			rstIndex <= 0;

      
		else

      
			rstIndex <= rstIndex + PUSH_WIDTH;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		pushCount = 0;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < PUSH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					if ((tailPtr + pushCount) >= SIZE)

      
						wa[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] = (tailPtr + pushCount) - SIZE;

      
					else

      
						wa[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] = tailPtr + pushCount;

      
					wv[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE+:ENTRY_BIT_SIZE] = pushedData[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE+:ENTRY_BIT_SIZE];

      
					we[i] = push[i];

      
					if (push[i])

      
						pushCount = pushCount + 1;

      
				end

      
		end

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < POP_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				if ((headPtr + i) >= SIZE)

      
					ra[((POP_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] = (headPtr + i) - SIZE;

      
				else

      
					ra[((POP_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] = headPtr + i;

      
		end

      
		popCount = 0;

      
		begin : sv2v_autoblock_3

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < POP_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					poppedData[((POP_WIDTH - 1) - i) * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE+:ENTRY_BIT_SIZE] = rv[((POP_WIDTH - 1) - popCount) * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE+:ENTRY_BIT_SIZE];

      
					if (pop[i])

      
						popCount = popCount + 1;

      
				end

      
		end

      
		if (rst) begin : sv2v_autoblock_4

      
			reg signed [31:0] i;

      
			for (i = 0; i < PUSH_WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
				begin

      
					wa[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] = rstIndex + i;

      
					wv[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * ENTRY_BIT_SIZE+:ENTRY_BIT_SIZE] = rstIndex + i;

      
					we[i] = (wa[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] >= rstIndex) && (wa[((PUSH_WIDTH - 1) - i) * INDEX_BIT_SIZE+:INDEX_BIT_SIZE] < SIZE);

      
				end

      
		end

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module QueuePointer (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	push,

      
	pop,

      
	full,

      
	empty,

      
	headPtr,

      
	tailPtr

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter SIZE = 1;

      
	parameter INITIAL_HEAD_PTR = 0;

      
	parameter INITIAL_TAIL_PTR = 0;

      
	parameter INITIAL_COUNT = 0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire push;

      
	input wire pop;

      
	output reg full;

      
	output reg empty;

      
	output reg [$clog2(SIZE) - 1:0] headPtr;

      
	output reg [$clog2(SIZE) - 1:0] tailPtr;

      
	localparam BIT_WIDTH = $clog2(SIZE);

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] regHeadStorage;

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] nextHeadStorage;

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] regTailStorage;

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] nextTailStorage;

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH:0] regCount;

      
	reg [BIT_WIDTH:0] nextCount;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			regHeadStorage <= INITIAL_HEAD_PTR;

      
			regTailStorage <= INITIAL_TAIL_PTR;

      
			regCount <= INITIAL_COUNT;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			regHeadStorage <= nextHeadStorage;

      
			regTailStorage <= nextTailStorage;

      
			regCount <= nextCount;

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		full = (regCount == SIZE ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		empty = (regCount == 0 ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		nextHeadStorage = regHeadStorage;

      
		nextTailStorage = regTailStorage;

      
		nextCount = regCount;

      
		if (push) begin

      
			if (regTailStorage == (SIZE - 1))

      
				nextTailStorage = 0;

      
			else

      
				nextTailStorage = nextTailStorage + 1;

      
			nextCount = nextCount + 1;

      
		end

      
		if (pop) begin

      
			if (regHeadStorage == (SIZE - 1))

      
				nextHeadStorage = 0;

      
			else

      
				nextHeadStorage = nextHeadStorage + 1;

      
			nextCount = nextCount - 1;

      
		end

      
		headPtr = regHeadStorage;

      
		tailPtr = regTailStorage;

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

			nextCount = nextCount + 1;

      
		end

      
		if (pop) begin

      
			if (regHeadStorage == (SIZE - 1))

      
				nextHeadStorage = 0;

      
			else

      
				nextHeadStorage = nextHeadStorage + 1;

      
			nextCount = nextCount - 1;

      
		end

      
		headPtr = regHeadStorage;

      
		tailPtr = regTailStorage;

      
		count = regCount;

module MultiWidthQueuePointer (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	push,

      
	pop,

      
	pushCount,

      
	popCount,

      
	headPtr,

      
	tailPtr,

      
	count

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

module Multiplier (

      
	srcA,

      
	srcB,

      
	dst

      
);

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire signed [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] srcA;

      
	input wire signed [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] srcB;

      
	output wire signed [(2 * BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] dst;

      
	assign dst = srcA * srcB;

      
endmodule

      
module SignExtender (

      
	in,

      
	sign,

      
	out

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] in;

      
	input wire sign;

      
	output reg [BIT_WIDTH:0] out;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		if (sign)

      
			out = {in[BIT_WIDTH - 1], in};

      
		else

      
			out = {1'b0, in};

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module PipelinedMultiplier (

      
	clk,

      
	stall,

      
	srcA,

      
	srcB,

      
	signA,

      
	signB,

      
	dst

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	parameter BIT_WIDTH = 32;

      
	parameter PIPELINE_DEPTH = 3;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire stall;

      
	input wire [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] srcA;

      
	input wire [BIT_WIDTH - 1:0] srcB;

      
	input wire signA;

      
	input wire signB;

      
	output reg [(2 * BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0] dst;

      
	localparam RESULT_PIPELINE_DEPTH = PIPELINE_DEPTH - 2;

      
	reg signed [(2 * BIT_WIDTH) + 1:0] pipeReg [0:RESULT_PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1];

      
	reg signed [(2 * BIT_WIDTH) + 1:0] mulResult;

      
	wire signed [BIT_WIDTH:0] exSrcA;

      
	wire signed [BIT_WIDTH:0] exSrcB;

      
	reg signed [BIT_WIDTH:0] exSrcA_Reg;

      
	reg signed [BIT_WIDTH:0] exSrcB_Reg;

      
	SignExtender #(.BIT_WIDTH(BIT_WIDTH)) signExtenderA(

      
		.in(srcA),

      
		.sign(signA),

      
		.out(exSrcA)

      
	);

      
	SignExtender #(.BIT_WIDTH(BIT_WIDTH)) signExtenderB(

      
		.in(srcB),

      
		.sign(signB),

      
		.out(exSrcB)

      
	);

      
	generate

      
		if (!(PIPELINE_DEPTH > 2)) begin : genblk1

      
			RSD_STATIC_ASSERT_FAILED non_existing_module();

      
		end

      
	endgenerate

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		(* use_dsp48 = "yes" *)

      
		mulResult = exSrcA_Reg * exSrcB_Reg;

      
		dst = pipeReg[RESULT_PIPELINE_DEPTH - 1][(2 * BIT_WIDTH) - 1:0];

      
	end

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (stall) begin

      
			exSrcA_Reg <= exSrcA_Reg;

      
			exSrcB_Reg <= exSrcB_Reg;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 0; i < RESULT_PIPELINE_DEPTH; i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i];

      
			end

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			exSrcA_Reg <= exSrcA;

      
			exSrcB_Reg <= exSrcB;

      
			pipeReg[0] <= mulResult;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				for (i = 1; i < RESULT_PIPELINE_DEPTH; i = i + 1)

      
					pipeReg[i] <= pipeReg[i - 1];

      
			end

      
		end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module Divider (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	req,

      
	dividend,

      
	divisor,

      
	isSigned,

      
	finished,

      
	quotient,

      
	remainder

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire req;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] dividend;

      
	input wire [31:0] divisor;

      
	input wire isSigned;

      
	output reg finished;

      
	output reg [31:0] quotient;

      
	output reg [31:0] remainder;

      
	parameter LOOP_COUNT = 33;

      
	parameter DIVIDER_WIDTH = LOOP_COUNT + 1;

      
	parameter DATA_MINUS_ONE = 34'sd4294967296 - 1;

      
	parameter DATA_MINIMUM = 33'sd2147483648;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regZ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextZ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regD;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextD;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regQ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextQ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regR;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextR;

      
	reg regSigned;

      
	reg nextSigned;

      
	reg [$clog2(LOOP_COUNT + 1) - 1:0] regCounter;

      
	reg [$clog2(LOOP_COUNT + 1) - 1:0] nextCounter;

      
	reg [1:0] regPhase;

      
	reg [1:0] nextPhase;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			regZ <= 0;

      
			regD <= 0;

      
			regQ <= 0;

      
			regR <= 0;

      
			regPhase <= 2'd0;

      
			regCounter <= 0;

      
			regSigned <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			regZ <= nextZ;

      
			regD <= nextD;

      
			regQ <= nextQ;

      
			regR <= nextR;

      
			regPhase <= nextPhase;

      
			regCounter <= nextCounter;

      
			regSigned <= nextSigned;

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		finished = (regPhase == 2'd0 ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		if (req) begin

      
			if (isSigned) begin

      
				nextZ = (dividend[31] ? {2'b11, dividend} : {2'b00, dividend});

      
				nextD = (divisor[31] ? {2'b11, divisor} : {2'b00, divisor});

      
			end

      
			else begin

      
				nextZ = {2'b00, dividend};

      
				nextD = {2'b00, divisor};

      
			end

      
			nextQ = 0;

      
			nextR = (nextZ[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] ? -1 : 0);

      
			nextSigned = isSigned;

      
			nextPhase = 2'd1;

      
			nextCounter = 0;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			nextZ = regZ;

      
			nextD = regD;

      
			nextQ = regQ;

      
			nextR = regR;

      
			nextSigned = regSigned;

      
			nextCounter = regCounter;

      
			if (regPhase == 2'd1) begin

      
				nextR = (regR << 1) | regZ[(LOOP_COUNT - 1) - regCounter];

      
				if (nextR[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != regD[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1]) begin

      
					nextR = nextR + regD;

      
					nextQ = regQ << 1;

      
				end

      
				else begin

      
					nextR = nextR - regD;

      
					nextQ = (regQ << 1) | 1;

      
				end

      
				nextCounter = regCounter + 1;

      
				nextPhase = (nextCounter >= LOOP_COUNT ? 2'd2 : 2'd1);

      
			end

      
			else if (regPhase == 2'd2) begin

      
				nextQ = (regQ << 1) + 1;

      
				nextR = regR;

      
				if (regR[32:0] == 0)

      
					;

      
				else begin

      
					if (regR[32:0] == regD[32:0]) begin

      
						nextR = nextR - regD;

      
						nextQ = nextQ + 1;

      
					end

      
					else if ((regR[32:0] + regD[32:0]) == 0) begin

      
						nextR = nextR + regD;

      
						nextQ = nextQ - 1;

      
					end

      
					else if (regZ[32] != regR[32]) begin

      
						if (regR[32] != regD[32]) begin

      
							nextR = nextR + regD;

      
							nextQ = nextQ - 1;

      
						end

      
						else begin

      
							nextR = nextR - regD;

      
							nextQ = nextQ + 1;

      
						end

      
					end

      
					if (regD == 0) begin

      
						nextQ = -1;

      
						nextR = regZ;

      
					end

      
					else if ((regSigned && (regZ == DATA_MINIMUM)) && (regD == DATA_MINUS_ONE)) begin

      
						nextQ = regZ;

      
						nextR = 0;

      
					end

      
				end

      
				nextPhase = 2'd0;

      
			end

      
			else

      
				nextPhase = regPhase;

      
		end

      
		quotient = regQ;

      
		remainder = regR;

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule

      
module QuickDivider (

      
	clk,

      
	rst,

      
	req,

      
	dividend,

      
	divisor,

      
	isSigned,

      
	finished,

      
	quotient,

      
	remainder

      
);

      
	reg _sv2v_0;

      
	input wire clk;

      
	input wire rst;

      
	input wire req;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_DATA_WIDTH = 32;

      
	input wire [31:0] dividend;

      
	input wire [31:0] divisor;

      
	input wire isSigned;

      
	output reg finished;

      
	output reg [31:0] quotient;

      
	output reg [31:0] remainder;

      
	parameter DIVIDER_WIDTH = 33;

      
	function automatic [$clog2(DIVIDER_WIDTH + 1) - 1:0] CountSignificantBits;

      
		input reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] dividend;

      
		reg [0:1] _sv2v_jump;

      
		begin

      
			_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
			CountSignificantBits = 1;

      
			begin : sv2v_autoblock_1

      
				reg signed [31:0] i;

      
				begin : sv2v_autoblock_2

      
					reg signed [31:0] _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
					for (i = DIVIDER_WIDTH - 2; i >= 0; i = i - 1)

      
						if (_sv2v_jump < 2'b10) begin

      
							_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
							if (dividend[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != dividend[i]) begin

      
								CountSignificantBits = i + 2;

      
								_sv2v_jump = 2'b10;

      
							end

      
							_sv2v_value_on_break = i;

      
						end

      
					if (!(_sv2v_jump < 2'b10))

      
						i = _sv2v_value_on_break;

      
					if (_sv2v_jump != 2'b11)

      
						_sv2v_jump = 2'b00;

      
				end

      
			end

      
		end

      
	endfunction

      
	parameter MAX_LOOP_COUNT = 33;

      
	parameter DATA_MINUS_ONE = 34'sd4294967296 - 1;

      
	parameter DATA_MINIMUM = 33'sd2147483648;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regZ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextZ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regD;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextD;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regQ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextQ;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] regR;

      
	reg [DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1:0] nextR;

      
	reg regSigned;

      
	reg nextSigned;

      
	reg [$clog2(MAX_LOOP_COUNT + 1) - 1:0] regCounter;

      
	reg [$clog2(MAX_LOOP_COUNT + 1) - 1:0] nextCounter;

      
	reg [1:0] regPhase;

      
	reg [1:0] nextPhase;

      
	localparam BasicTypes_FALSE = 1'b0;

      
	always @(posedge clk)

      
		if (rst) begin

      
			regZ <= 0;

      
			regD <= 0;

      
			regQ <= 0;

      
			regR <= 0;

      
			regPhase <= 2'd0;

      
			regCounter <= 0;

      
			regSigned <= BasicTypes_FALSE;

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			regZ <= nextZ;

      
			regD <= nextD;

      
			regQ <= nextQ;

      
			regR <= nextR;

      
			regPhase <= nextPhase;

      
			regCounter <= nextCounter;

      
			regSigned <= nextSigned;

      
		end

      
	localparam BasicTypes_TRUE = 1'b1;

      
	always @(*) begin

      
		if (_sv2v_0)

      
			;

      
		finished = (regPhase == 2'd0 ? BasicTypes_TRUE : BasicTypes_FALSE);

      
		if (req) begin

      
			if (isSigned) begin

      
				nextZ = (dividend[31] ? {1'b1, dividend} : {1'b0, dividend});

      
				nextD = (divisor[31] ? {1'b1, divisor} : {1'b0, divisor});

      
			end

      
			else begin

      
				nextZ = {1'b0, dividend};

      
				nextD = {1'b0, divisor};

      
			end

      
			nextQ = 0;

      
			nextR = (nextZ[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] ? -1 : 0);

      
			nextSigned = isSigned;

      
			nextPhase = 2'd1;

      
			nextCounter = CountSignificantBits(nextZ);

      
		end

      
		else begin

      
			nextZ = regZ;

      
			nextD = regD;

      
			nextQ = regQ;

      
			nextR = regR;

      
			nextSigned = regSigned;

      
			nextCounter = regCounter;

      
			if (regPhase == 2'd1) begin

      
				nextR = (regR << 1) | regZ[regCounter - 1];

      
				if (regR[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != regD[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1]) begin

      
					nextR = nextR + regD;

      
					nextQ = -1;

      
				end

      
				else begin

      
					nextR = nextR - regD;

      
					nextQ = 0;

      
				end

      
				nextCounter = regCounter - 1;

      
				nextPhase = (nextCounter == 0 ? 2'd3 : 2'd2);

      
			end

      
			else if (regPhase == 2'd2) begin

      
				nextR = (regR << 1) | regZ[regCounter - 1];

      
				if (regR[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != regD[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1]) begin

      
					nextR = nextR + regD;

      
					nextQ = regQ << 1;

      
				end

      
				else begin

      
					nextR = nextR - regD;

      
					nextQ = (regQ << 1) | 1;

      
				end

      
				nextCounter = regCounter - 1;

      
				nextPhase = (nextCounter == 0 ? 2'd3 : 2'd2);

      
			end

      
			else if (regPhase == 2'd3) begin

      
				nextQ = (regQ << 1) + 1;

      
				nextR = regR;

      
				if (regR == 0)

      
					;

      
				else if (regR == regD) begin

      
					nextR = nextR - regD;

      
					nextQ = nextQ + 1;

      
				end

      
				else if (regR == -regD) begin

      
					nextR = nextR + regD;

      
					nextQ = nextQ - 1;

      
				end

      
				else if (regR[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != regZ[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1]) begin

      
					if (regR[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1] != regD[DIVIDER_WIDTH - 1]) begin

      
						nextR = nextR + regD;

      
						nextQ = nextQ - 1;

      
					end

      
					else begin

      
						nextR = nextR - regD;

      
						nextQ = nextQ + 1;

      
					end

      
				end

      
				if (regD == 0) begin

      
					nextQ = -1;

      
					nextR = regZ;

      
				end

      
				else if ((regSigned && (regZ == DATA_MINIMUM)) && (regD == DATA_MINUS_ONE)) begin

      
					nextQ = regZ;

      
					nextR = 0;

      
				end

      
				nextPhase = 2'd0;

      
			end

      
			else

      
				nextPhase = regPhase;

      
		end

      
		quotient = regQ;

      
		remainder = regR;

      
	end

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule
